senses.en: A long research paper written for a university degree.
A central claim that someone presents and supports with evidence.

ex.en: The textbook introduces doctoral thesis in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了博士论文。

ex.en: The reading connects doctoral thesis with a larger point about student life.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把博士论文和关于校园生活的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: write a thesis｜撰写学位论文
submit a thesis｜提交学位论文
tip: 复数是theses；既可指学位论文，也可指核心论点。

senses.en: Feel or show great happiness about something.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to rejoice at the news.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求为消息感到欣喜。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers rejoice at the news before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要为消息感到欣喜。

col: rejoice at the news｜为消息感到欣喜
rejoice in someone's success｜为某人的成功欢喜
tip: 较正式；常用rejoice at/in或接that从句。

senses.en: The beginning of something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sudden onset.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论突然发作。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of sudden onset.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得突然发作这个例子。

col: the onset of symptoms｜症状的出现
the onset of winter｜冬季的来临
tip: 常用the onset of，多指疾病或不利情况的开始。

senses.en: The splitting of an atomic nucleus, usually releasing energy.
Reproduction in which one organism divides into separate organisms.

ex.en: Our professor circled nuclear fission on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了核裂变。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of nuclear fission.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得核裂变这个例子。

tip: 核物理中fission是裂变，fusion是聚变。

senses.en: A group of young birds born to the same mother.
To keep thinking unhappily about something.
To sit on eggs or young birds to keep them warm.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a brood of chicks.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一窝雏鸟。

ex.en: A campus survey used a brood of chicks to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用一窝雏鸟来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a brood of chicks｜一窝雏鸟
brood over a mistake｜对一个错误耿耿于怀
brood on the past｜为往事忧思
tip: 作动词表忧思时常接over或on。

senses.en: Give up control, possession or a right to something.

ex.en: The professor asked us to relinquish control.
ex.zh: 教授让我们放弃控制权。

ex.en: The reading asks you to relinquish control and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你放弃控制权，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: relinquish a claim｜放弃权利主张
tip: 正式及物动词，直接接control、power、rights等。

senses.en: Gather the courage, strength, or support needed to do something.
Bring people together, especially for military duties.
A gathering of people, especially soldiers, for inspection or duty.

ex.en: The assignment is to muster the courage, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先鼓起勇气，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers muster the courage before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要鼓起勇气。

tip: muster courage指鼓起勇气；pass muster指合格。

senses.en: Too small or unimportant to deserve much attention.
Unkindly concerned with small, unimportant matters.
Relatively minor or small in scale, especially concerning crime.

ex.en: Our professor circled petty crime on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了轻微犯罪。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss petty crime.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论轻微犯罪的材料。

tip: 形容人时常含贬义，指小心眼，不只是小气。

senses.en: A good reason explaining why something is acceptable or necessary.

ex.en: I copied little justification into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把几乎没有正当理由抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around little justification.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕几乎没有正当理由展开说明。

col: little justification｜几乎没有正当理由
economic justification｜经济上的合理依据
tip: 常接for加名词或动名词，说明某事的合理依据。

senses.en: A rock mainly composed of calcium carbonate, often from marine remains.

ex.en: Our professor circled limestone cliffs on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了石灰岩峭壁。

ex.en: The author returns to limestone cliffs when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了石灰岩峭壁。

tip: limestone通常不可数；lime还可指石灰或青柠。

senses.en: one half of the Earth
either of the two halves of the brain

ex.en: Our professor circled northern hemisphere on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了北半球。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of northern hemisphere.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得北半球这个例子。

tip: 地理中指地球的一半，也可指大脑半球。

senses.en: a new activity or business involving risk
to go somewhere or do something despite possible risks
to express an opinion despite uncertainty about the response

ex.en: Our professor circled joint venture on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了合资企业。

ex.en: The author returns to joint venture when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了合资企业。

col: venture an opinion｜冒昧发表意见
tip: venture本身不等于风险投资；风险资本是venture capital。

senses.en: Collect information from different sources and arrange it together.
Convert computer code into a form a computer can run.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to compile a report.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何编写报告。

ex.en: A lecture on technological change showed why researchers compile a report before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于技术变革的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要编写报告。

tip: 强调从不同来源收集并整理，不只是写作。

senses.en: Easily harmed, attacked, or negatively affected.

ex.en: Our professor circled vulnerable to disease on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了易患病的。

ex.en: A campus survey used vulnerable to disease to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用易患病的来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 常用 vulnerable to，to 后接名词。

senses.en: a unit of land area equal to ten thousand square metres

ex.en: Office hours began with a hectare of land.
ex.zh: 答疑从一公顷土地开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a hectare of land.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一公顷土地的材料。

col: a hectare of land｜一公顷土地
tip: 公顷是面积单位；一公顷等于一万平方米。

senses.en: To force many things or people into a small space.
To study intensively shortly before an examination.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer cram into a bag during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时硬塞进包里。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cram into a bag.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得硬塞进包里。

col: cram into a bag｜硬塞进包里
cram a room with people｜让房间挤满人
cram for an exam｜考前突击复习
tip: 过去式crammed；复习考试用cram for。

senses.en: Aiming for morally admirable or very ambitious achievements.
Rising to a great height.
Showing a belief that you are better than others.

ex.en: The textbook introduces lofty ideals in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了崇高的理想。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of lofty ideals.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得崇高的理想这个例子。

tip: 修饰理想时可表赞许，也可暗示目标过高、不切实际。

senses.en: to cause someone or something to enter a particular state
to provide help, a service, or something needed
to represent something in artistic or visual form

ex.en: The lab instructions say to render assistance.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求提供援助。

ex.en: The passage says students who can render assistance follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够提供援助的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: render something useless｜使某物失去用途
tip: 表“使……”时常用render＋宾语＋形容词，语气正式。

senses.zh: 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的
senses.en: widely known for something bad or undesirable

ex.en: Our professor circled notorious for on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了因…而臭名昭著。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss notorious for.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论因…而臭名昭著的材料。

tip: 通常含贬义；著名但非负面用famous，不宜用notorious。

senses.en: able to cause death

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on potentially lethal.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可能致命的。

ex.en: The reading connects potentially lethal with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可能致命的和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常作形容词；lethal 强调具有致死能力。

senses.en: Someone or something with a similar role in another setting.

ex.en: Office hours began with a foreign counterpart.
ex.zh: 答疑从国外的对等人员开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a foreign counterpart when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了国外的对等人员。

col: a foreign counterpart｜国外的对等人员
a rural counterpart｜农村的对应对象
a digital counterpart｜数字化的对应版本
tip: 强调在另一地区或机构中角色相当，不是对手。

senses.en: To make movement or progress slower or more difficult.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer impede progress during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时阻碍进展。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to impede progress.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得阻碍进展。

tip: 强调使进展困难或缓慢，不一定完全阻止。

senses.en: acting or speaking as though more important than others

ex.en: Our professor circled sound pompous on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了听起来自大。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sound pompous.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕听起来自大展开说明。

tip: 含贬义，重点是自命不凡，不只是外表华丽。

senses.en: An idea or plan offered for consideration
A statement that can be examined as true or false

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a business proposition.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论商业提议。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a business proposition.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得商业提议这个例子。

col: an attractive proposition｜有吸引力的提议
support a proposition｜支持一项主张
tip: 作主张讲可接 that 从句；提议常用 proposal。

senses.en: a hard mineral common in rocks and used in electronics

ex.en: Office hours began with rose quartz.
ex.zh: 答疑从粉晶开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used rose quartz to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用粉晶来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；一块石英用 a piece of quartz。

senses.en: Unfair, unnecessary, or inappropriate in a particular situation.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize uncalled-for in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出无理的。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses uncalled-for when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了无理的。

tip: 常形容批评或言论无理，不只是数量多余。

senses.en: to fill someone's thoughts, leaving little attention for other things

ex.en: The assignment is to preoccupy someone's mind, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先占据某人的心思，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to preoccupy someone's mind.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来占据某人的心思。

col: be preoccupied with work｜一心想着工作
preoccupy someone's mind｜占据某人的心思
tip: 常用be preoccupied with，指心思被某事占据。

senses.en: to confirm someone is reliable or something is true

ex.en: The assignment is to vouch for the accuracy of, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先保证……的准确性，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to vouch for the accuracy of.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来保证……的准确性。

col: vouch for the accuracy of｜保证……的准确性
vouch for the quality of｜保证……的质量
tip: 通常用vouch for，不直接接担保的人或事物。

senses.en: To bring separate parts or groups together as one.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to unify a country.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何统一国家。

ex.en: The reading asks you to unify a country and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你统一国家，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: unify different groups｜使不同群体团结
tip: unify强调把分散部分合成整体，可用于制度或群体。

senses.en: happening repeatedly, often at regular intervals

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on periodic checks.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论定期检查。

ex.en: The author returns to periodic checks when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了定期检查。

tip: periodic是形容词，不是名词；副词为periodically。

senses.en: Happening or found often enough to seem ordinary.
Something ordinary, or a familiar statement lacking originality.

ex.en: Our professor circled increasingly commonplace on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了越来越常见。

ex.en: The reading connects increasingly commonplace with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把越来越常见和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 多指常见到不足为奇，不一定含贬义。

senses.en: Giving benefits or improving the chances of success

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mutually advantageous.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论互惠互利的。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mutually advantageous.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论互惠互利的的材料。

tip: 常用be advantageous to sb表示对某人有利。

senses.en: Showing kindness by choosing not to punish or hurt someone.
Providing welcome relief from suffering or discomfort.

ex.en: Office hours began with a merciful judge.
ex.zh: 答疑从宽大的法官开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a merciful judge.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得宽大的法官这个例子。

col: be merciful to someone｜对某人仁慈
a merciful release｜令人解脱的结束
tip: 对某人仁慈用be merciful to someone。

senses.en: someone who gives public talks about religious beliefs
someone who strongly promotes particular beliefs or behaviour

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a local preacher.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于当地布道者的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a local preacher.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论当地布道者的材料。

col: a preacher of peace｜和平的倡导者
tip: preacher侧重讲道，missionary侧重传播宗教。

senses.en: Likely or willing to think or act a certain way.
Sloping rather than horizontal or vertical.

ex.en: I copied an inclined plane into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把斜面抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used an inclined plane to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用斜面来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: be inclined to agree｜倾向于同意
tip: be inclined to后接动词原形，表示倾向或意愿。

senses.en: A country's independent authority to govern itself.

ex.en: The textbook introduces national sovereignty in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了国家主权。

ex.en: A campus survey used national sovereignty to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用国家主权来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；对某领土的主权用over连接。

senses.en: To reproduce conditions or processes for testing, training, or study.
To pretend to have a feeling or condition.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to simulate conditions.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何模拟条件。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to simulate conditions.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得模拟条件。

col: simulate an emergency｜模拟紧急情况
simulate the effects of｜模拟……的影响
tip: 模拟环境用simulate；刺激发展用stimulate。

senses.en: to start a line further inward than the surrounding lines
to make a hollow or notch in a surface

ex.en: I heard the lecturer indent a paragraph during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时缩进段落。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to indent a paragraph.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们缩进段落。

col: indent the first line｜缩进首行
tip: 指行首向内移动，不是把整行内容缩短。

senses.en: a system of beliefs shaping political or social views

ex.en: I copied political ideology into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把政治意识形态抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects political ideology with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把政治意识形态和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: share an ideology｜持有共同理念
tip: 指成体系的社会或政治观念，不是单个想法。

senses.en: a social rule against discussing or doing something
considered unacceptable to discuss or do within a particular group

ex.en: I copied a taboo subject into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把忌讳的话题抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a taboo subject.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕忌讳的话题展开说明。

tip: 名词指禁忌；形容词可说a taboo subject。

senses.en: to strengthen a place or structure against attack or damage
to make someone physically or mentally stronger
to add nutrients to food to improve its nutritional value

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to fortify coastal defences.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何加强海岸防御。

ex.en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to fortify coastal defences.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们加强海岸防御。

col: fortify coastal defences｜加强海岸防御
fortify food with vitamins｜给食品添加维生素
fortify yourself against｜增强自身力量以抵御
tip: fortify A with B：用B增强A。

senses.en: A machine or structure that burns waste at high temperatures

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about waste incinerator.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于垃圾焚烧炉的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used waste incinerator to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用垃圾焚烧炉来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: 通常指废物焚烧炉；火葬场用crematorium。

senses.en: highest in rank, authority, or importance
of the greatest possible degree

ex.en: Our professor circled supreme court on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了最高法院。

ex.en: The author returns to supreme court when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了最高法院。

tip: 本身含“最高”之意，通常不用比较级或最高级。

senses.en: confidence and willingness to take risks or challenge expectations
the quality of being visually strong and noticeable

ex.en: Office hours began with political boldness.
ex.zh: 答疑从政治勇气开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used political boldness to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用政治勇气来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: the boldness of the colours｜色彩的鲜明
tip: 可指行动大胆，也可指设计或色彩醒目。

senses.en: using careful examination of details to understand something

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on analytic approach.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论分析方法。

ex.en: The reading connects analytic approach with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把分析方法和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 与analytical意思接近；日常描述分析能力更常用后者。

senses.en: A difference between things that should match.

ex.en: I copied a significant discrepancy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把显著差异抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a significant discrepancy with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把显著差异和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常指本应一致却不符，搭配 between 或 in。

senses.en: the process of making a sound or signal stronger
an increase in the strength or effect of something

ex.en: Our professor circled sound amplification on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了扩音。

ex.en: A campus survey used sound amplification to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用扩音来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 常指声音、信号的增强，也可指影响被放大。

senses.en: Greater importance that gives someone or something priority over others.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize precedence in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出优先权。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up precedence while discussing evidence about public institutions.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共制度的证据时提到了优先权。

tip: 常用take precedence over，表示优先于。

senses.en: The power to evoke shared feelings, memories, or understanding.
The deep, full quality of a sound.
Stronger vibration caused by matching an object's natural frequency.

ex.en: Our professor circled emotional resonance on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了情感共鸣。

ex.en: The reading connects emotional resonance with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把情感共鸣和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 情感义常用have resonance for；物理义指共振。

senses.en: Showing that you are sorry for something.

ex.en: I copied an apologetic smile into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把歉意的微笑抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an apologetic smile.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕歉意的微笑展开说明。

tip: 常接about或for说明歉意的缘由。

senses.en: a medical examination of a body to determine death's cause
an examination of a completed event, especially an unsuccessful one
happening or performed after death

ex.en: Office hours began with postmortem examination.
ex.zh: 答疑从尸体检验开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around postmortem examination.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕尸体检验展开说明。

tip: 英式也常写post-mortem；可比喻赛后或项目复盘。

senses.en: to confirm officially that something is true or meets standards

ex.en: The assignment is to certify that, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先正式证明……，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers certify that before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要正式证明……。

col: certified organic｜经认证的有机产品
tip: 强调正式或权威证明，常用certify that从句。

senses.en: to become stronger or make a feeling or effect stronger

ex.en: The lab instructions say to heighten awareness.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求提高意识。

ex.en: The reading asks you to heighten awareness and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你提高意识，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 多用于情绪、意识或效果增强，不常指身高增长。

senses.en: To publicly support a policy, idea, or course of action.
Someone who publicly supports a cause or policy.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to advocate reform.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何提倡改革。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to advocate reform.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们提倡改革。

col: a strong advocate of｜……的坚定支持者
tip: 名词末尾读/kət/；动词可接动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: An adult female tiger.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a wild tigress in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了野生雌虎。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a wild tigress.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕野生雌虎展开说明。

col: a tigress and her cubs｜母虎和它的幼崽
tip: tigress专指雌虎；tiger可泛指老虎，不一定是雄虎。

senses.en: A natural ability to learn or do something well

ex.en: The textbook introduces an aptitude for languages in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了语言天赋。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an aptitude for languages.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕语言天赋展开说明。

col: an aptitude for languages｜语言天赋
show an aptitude for｜展现出某方面的天赋
tip: 常用aptitude for，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to make someone feel deeply ashamed or foolish

ex.en: The assignment is to humiliate someone publicly, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先公开羞辱某人，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers humiliate someone publicly before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要公开羞辱某人。

col: humiliate someone publicly｜公开羞辱某人
tip: 比embarrass语气更重，强调受辱和尊严受损。

senses.en: Careful examination of something, especially to find faults or problems.

ex.en: The textbook introduces public scrutiny in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公众监督。

ex.en: The author returns to public scrutiny when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公众监督。

tip: 不可数名词；under scrutiny表示受到严格审查。

senses.en: an animal, such as a frog, living in water and on land
a vehicle or aircraft able to operate on land and water

ex.en: The textbook introduces amphibian species in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了两栖动物物种。

ex.en: A campus survey used amphibian species to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用两栖动物物种来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 动物名词用amphibian；两栖的常用amphibious。

senses.en: The process of making something stronger or more effective.
Encouragement that makes a behaviour more likely to happen again.
Extra people sent to support an existing group or force.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on positive reinforcement.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论正向强化。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around positive reinforcement.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕正向强化展开说明。

tip: 表示援军、增援人员时通常用复数reinforcements。

senses.en: To invent false information in order to deceive
To make a product or structure from separate materials

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to fabricate evidence.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须伪造证据。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to fabricate evidence.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得伪造证据。

tip: 既可指捏造信息，也可指工业制造，须看宾语。

senses.en: Feeling, showing, or causing deep sadness.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about sorrowful expression.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于悲伤的表情的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sorrowful expression.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕悲伤的表情展开说明。

tip: 比sad更正式，常用于表情、声音或告别。

senses.en: to commit more money or effort than can be managed

ex.en: The assignment is to overextend yourself, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先使自己负担过重，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The passage says students who can overextend yourself follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够使自己负担过重的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: overextend financially｜在财务上超出承受能力
tip: 常用 overextend oneself，指承担超出能力的任务或开支。

senses.en: a departure from an expected route, rule, or behaviour
the difference between a measurement and a reference value

ex.en: Our professor circled standard deviation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了标准差。

ex.en: A campus survey used standard deviation to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用标准差来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: deviation from the norm｜偏离常态
tip: 常用 deviation from；standard deviation 是“标准差”。

senses.en: The scientific study of light and how it behaves

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about geometrical optics.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于几何光学的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around geometrical optics.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕几何光学展开说明。

tip: 表示光学这门学科时，虽以s结尾仍接单数谓语。

senses.en: A mistake caused by failing to notice or consider something.
Responsibility for checking that activities are managed correctly.

ex.en: Office hours began with an unfortunate oversight.
ex.zh: 答疑从令人遗憾的疏忽开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an unfortunate oversight.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论令人遗憾的疏忽的材料。

col: an unfortunate oversight｜令人遗憾的疏忽
tip: 作“疏忽”通常可数；作“监督”通常不可数。

senses.en: Relating to time or the order of events.
Relating to worldly affairs rather than spiritual matters.
Relating to the sides of the head near the temples.

ex.en: The textbook introduces temporal order in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了时间顺序。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of temporal order.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得时间顺序这个例子。

tip: temporal指时间的；temporary才表示暂时的。

senses.en: unnecessary because it is no longer needed or repeats something
having lost a job because the employer no longer needs it

ex.en: Our professor circled redundant information on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了多余信息。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of redundant information.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得多余信息这个例子。

tip: 英式英语中be made redundant指岗位取消而被裁员。

senses.en: morally right or acting according to strong moral principles
arising from a belief that you are morally right

ex.en: I copied righteous anger into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把义愤抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss righteous anger.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论义愤的材料。

tip: 语气较庄重；self-righteous指自以为正直。

senses.en: less strict or severe when enforcing rules or giving punishment

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a lenient sentence.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论从轻的判刑。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a lenient sentence.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得从轻的判刑这个例子。

tip: 对人宽容用lenient with；常涉及规则或处罚。

senses.en: To put something at risk of harm, loss, or failure.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to jeopardise safety.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须危及安全。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to jeopardise safety.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们危及安全。

col: jeopardise a career｜损害职业前途
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；美式通常拼作jeopardize。

senses.en: Rise and fall irregularly in level, amount, or value.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer fluctuate widely during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时大幅波动。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to fluctuate widely.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们大幅波动。

tip: 通常是不及物动词；在两值间波动用between。

senses.en: The practice of following a rule, law, or custom
A ceremony performed as part of religion or tradition

ex.en: I copied strict observance into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把严格遵守抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of strict observance.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得严格遵守这个例子。

tip: observance指遵守或仪式；observation指观察。

senses.en: expressing a meaning opposite to the words used
strangely opposite to what would normally be expected

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an ironical remark.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于反讽的话的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects an ironical remark with a larger point about public communication.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把反讽的话和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an ironical twist｜讽刺性的转折
tip: 与ironic基本同义，但ironic更常用；不一定含恶意。

senses.en: To spread out or make people or things spread out

ex.en: The lab instructions say to disperse a crowd.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求驱散人群。

ex.en: The passage says students who can disperse a crowd follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够驱散人群的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 既可及物也可不及物：驱散人群或人群散去。

senses.en: an organism such as a mushroom, mould, or yeast

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on soil fungus.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论土壤真菌。

ex.en: The reading connects soil fungus with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把土壤真菌和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 复数常用fungi；真菌不属于植物。

senses.en: an idea accepted as the basis for reasoning or action
the buildings and land used by a business or organization

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on basic premise.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论基本前提。

ex.en: The reading connects basic premise with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把基本前提和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: on the premise that｜以……为前提
tip: 表示房屋及场地时用复数premises。

senses.en: the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances
the quality of being morally good or unmixed in character

ex.en: I copied water purity into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把水的纯净度抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used water purity to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用水的纯净度来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 不可数名词；表示具体纯度常用the purity of。

senses.en: The freedom or right to make decisions independently.

ex.en: I copied greater autonomy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把更大的自主权抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used greater autonomy to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用更大的自主权来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；既指地区自治，也指个人或机构自主。

senses.en: Practical knowledge and skills needed to do something successfully

ex.en: After the lecture, we used know-how in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了实用技能。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses know-how when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了实用技能。

tip: 不可数名词，强调实际操作能力，拼写保留连字符。

senses.en: Quick and energetic.

senses.zh: 生意兴隆的；交易活跃的
senses.en: Involving a lot of buying and selling.
Cold and fresh in a pleasant, energising way.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a brisk walk.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论快步行走。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a brisk walk.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得快步行走这个例子。

tip: brisk walk指轻快有力的快走，不是跑步。

senses.en: A substance made of large molecules containing repeated smaller units.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on synthetic polymer.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论合成聚合物。

ex.en: The reading connects synthetic polymer with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把合成聚合物和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: biodegradable polymer｜可生物降解聚合物
tip: 聚合物不只包括塑料，也包括淀粉等天然物质。

senses.zh: 地道的；符合语言习惯的
senses.en: natural and typical of how fluent speakers use a language
containing or relating to expressions with nonliteral meanings

ex.en: Office hours began with idiomatic English.
ex.zh: 答疑从地道的英语开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used idiomatic English to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用地道的英语来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 地道不等于堆砌习语；自然搭配也体现idiomatic。

senses.en: To replace something older or no longer useful.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to supersede existing rules.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求取代现有规则。

ex.en: The reading asks you to supersede existing rules and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你取代现有规则，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: supersede existing rules｜取代现有规则
supersede earlier versions｜取代早期版本
tip: 注意拼写结尾是-sede，不是-cede；常用被动式。

senses.en: an official count of people that collects information about them

ex.en: The textbook introduces a national census in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了全国人口普查。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a national census.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕全国人口普查展开说明。

col: conduct a census｜开展人口普查
a national census｜全国人口普查
tip: census调查全部人口，sample survey只抽样。

senses.en: A hard, silvery metal used in alloys and batteries.
A coin worth five cents in the US or Canada.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about nickel mining.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于镍矿开采的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used nickel mining to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用镍矿开采来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 指金属时不可数；指五分硬币时可数。

senses.en: An action that breaks a law or violates someone's rights.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on copyright infringement.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论侵犯版权。

ex.en: The author returns to copyright infringement when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了侵犯版权。

tip: 常接of；infringement of rights指侵犯权利。

senses.en: To improve something by adding value, interest, or experience.
To make someone wealthier.
To improve food or soil by adding useful substances.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to enrich people's lives.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何丰富人们的生活。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to enrich people's lives.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来丰富人们的生活。

col: enrich people's lives｜丰富人们的生活
tip: enrich是及物动词，常接life、experience或soil。

senses.zh: 极其巨大的；天文数字的
senses.en: Extremely large, especially when describing prices, costs, or amounts.
Relating to the scientific study of stars, planets, and space.

ex.en: Office hours began with astronomical costs.
ex.zh: 答疑从巨额成本开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss astronomical costs.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论巨额成本的材料。

col: astronomical sums｜天文数字般的金额
tip: 谈费用时常表示高得惊人；也可表示天文学的。

senses.en: Having a bad reputation and not deserving trust or respect.
Looking untidy, worn, or unsuitable for respectable company.

ex.en: The textbook introduces disreputable company in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了名声不佳的公司。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss disreputable company.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论名声不佳的公司的材料。

tip: 通常指名声或行为不佳，不只是外表破旧。

senses.en: likely to attack or cause serious harm
deliberately cruel and intended to hurt someone

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on vicious attack.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论凶残的袭击。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vicious attack.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕凶残的袭击展开说明。

tip: vicious circle指问题互相加剧的“恶性循环”。

senses.en: Worry intensely while trying to make a difficult decision

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to agonize over a decision.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何为决定而苦恼。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers agonize over a decision before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要为决定而苦恼。

col: agonize over a decision｜为决定而苦恼
agonize about the future｜为未来焦虑
tip: 常用agonize over/about；英式也拼作agonise。

senses.en: The force or process that moves something forward

ex.en: Office hours began with electric propulsion.
ex.zh: 答疑从电力推进开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of electric propulsion.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得电力推进这个例子。

tip: 通常为不可数名词，常用于船舶、飞机和航天器。

senses.en: friendly and peaceful, without conflict
having parts that look or sound pleasing together

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about harmonious relationship.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于融洽的关系的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of harmonious relationship.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得融洽的关系这个例子。

tip: 既可形容人际关系融洽，也可形容色彩、声音协调。

senses.en: Relating to hearing or the sense of hearing

ex.en: The textbook introduces aural skills in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了听辨能力。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of aural skills.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得听辨能力这个例子。

tip: aural指听觉的；oral指口头的或口腔的。

senses.en: To make someone seem foolish by laughing at or imitating them.
Made to imitate something real, often for practice.
A practice examination taken before the real one.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to mock someone's accent.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须嘲笑某人的口音。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to mock someone's accent.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来嘲笑某人的口音。

col: mock someone's accent｜嘲笑某人的口音
tip: mock作动词直接接宾语，不加at。

senses.en: Physical or mental effort, especially when it makes you tired.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about physical exertion.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于体力消耗的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around physical exertion.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕体力消耗展开说明。

tip: 多指消耗体力或脑力，不等同于表示尽力的try hard。

senses.en: Acts intended to destroy a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group.

ex.en: Office hours began with commit genocide.
ex.zh: 答疑从实施种族灭绝开始。

ex.en: The reading connects commit genocide with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把实施种族灭绝和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: victims of genocide｜种族灭绝的受害者
tip: 不泛指大规模杀戮，核心是蓄意毁灭特定群体。

senses.zh: 会犯错的；不完全可靠的
senses.en: Capable of making mistakes or being wrong

ex.en: I copied fallible human judgement into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把可能出错的人类判断抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fallible human judgement.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可能出错的人类判断的材料。

col: fallible human judgement｜可能出错的人类判断
a fallible system｜不完全可靠的系统
tip: 强调可能犯错，并非一定错误；反义词为infallible。

senses.en: to conduct business or carry out a business deal

ex.en: The assignment is to transact business, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先办理业务，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers transact business before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要办理业务。

tip: 正式用语，常用transact business表示开展业务。
